name: Neural Radiance & SDF
description: Optical and photorealistic agent: models mathematical continuous surfaces with Signed Distance Fields (SDF), smooth union, PBR, subsurface scattering, and raymarched soft shadows.
capabilities: SDF primitive generation with spherical, toroidal, and prismatic smooth-union
Advanced PBR rendering with metallicity, roughness, and subsurface scattering (SSS)
Three-point cinematic lighting: key light, fill light, and backlight
Multi-stage ambient occlusion and soft shadow calculation
Instant archiving into the visual catalog
